code: run_stream <- function(detector) {   model <- stealthy(cla_nb("target", c("FALSE", "TRUE")), detector, warmup_size = 100)   results <- NULL   for (b in 2:max(batch)) {     train <- batch == (b - 1)     test <- batch == b     model <- fit(model, x[train, ], y[train, , drop = FALSE])      accuracy <- NA     if (model$fitted) {       prediction <- predict(model, x[test, ])       accuracy <- mean((prediction[, 2] > 0.5) == (y$target[test] == "TRUE"))     }     results <- rbind(results, data.frame(batch = b, drifted = model$drifted, accuracy = accuracy))   }   results } without_detector <- run_stream(dfr_inactive()) with_ddm <- run_stream(dfr_ddm())  with_ddm[with_ddm$drifted, ] #>    batch drifted accuracy #> 9     10    TRUE       NA #> 17    18    TRUE       NA #> 20    21    TRUE       NA #> 23    24    TRUE       NA #> 25    26    TRUE       NA plot(without_detector$batch, without_detector$accuracy,   type = "b", pch = 16,   ylim = c(0.4, 1), col = "grey50", xlab = "batch", ylab = "accuracy" ) lines(with_ddm$batch, with_ddm$accuracy, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "steelblue") abline(v = 750 / 50 + 0.5, lty = 2, col = "grey70") legend("bottomleft", c("dfr_inactive()", "dfr_ddm()"),   col = c("grey50", "steelblue"),   pch = 16, bty = "n", cex = 0.8 ) after <- with_ddm$batch > 16 c(   without_detector = mean(without_detector$accuracy[after], na.rm = TRUE),   with_ddm = mean(with_ddm$accuracy[after], na.rm = TRUE) ) #> without_detector         with_ddm  #>        0.4457143        0.9100000

code: # Load Heimdall and the synthetic stream example. library(heimdall)  # Fix the seed for reproducibility. seed <- 1 set.seed(seed)  # Load the univariate numeric stream monitored in this example. data(st_drift_examples) serie <- st_drift_examples$uv_virtual_drift  # Plot the monitored signal before detection. plot(x=seq_len(nrow(serie)), y=serie$serie)  # Instantiate the Page-Hinkley detector. model <- dfr_page_hinkley(target_feat='serie')  # Update the detector sequentially and record every drift alarm. detection <- NULL output <- list(obj=model, drift=FALSE) for (i in seq_len(nrow(serie))){   output <- update_state(output$obj, serie$serie[i])   if (output$drift){     type <- 'drift'     output$obj <- reset_state(output$obj)   } else {     type <- ''   }   detection <- rbind(detection, data.frame(idx=i, event=output$drift, type=type)) }  # Print the detected drift points. detection[detection$type == 'drift',] #>     idx event  type #> 205 205  TRUE drift  # Overlay those alarms on the original numeric stream. plot(x=seq_len(nrow(serie)), y=serie$serie) for (drift_index in detection[detection$type == 'drift', 'idx']) {   abline(v=drift_index, col='red', lty=2) }   print(paste('Successfull run at', Sys.time())) #> [1] "Successfull run at 2026-10-16 11:15:23.111951"
